title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
lede: In his first all-hands since being reinstated, Jensen Huang apologized to Nvidia staff, said he is in therapy, and credited the Trump administration with helping the board clear his return.

points: CNBC described a remorseful tone, with Huang telling employees he had hurt all of them.
He admitted breaking Nvidia's code of conduct, which he largely wrote, and said it still applies but mitigating circumstances matter.
He played down President Trump's role, though Trump reportedly called the board directly to back him.
Per the Wall Street Journal, he thanked the administration for fast access to intelligence that helped the board judge the security risk as low.
He faces a public Senate Banking hearing next week and several closed House committee hearings in the weeks after.
